about: Facing (issue #188): four NPCs of our own (npc/facing.txt, Orc Warrior looks) face rathena's directions 0 (north), 2 (west), 4 (south) and 6 (east) near prontera 156 180. North shows the back, south faces the camera, west looks left and east right; Prontera's own south-facing NPCs above them face the camera too. The NPCs live only in the map server's memory, and the scenario unloads them at both ends.
